page.layout: One page of verse in a single column, below a running head and a title; catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

p.i: Hic laudis meruit decus perenne, Qui vitri geminos nitentis orbes Primus, eximiæ Magister artis, Nasis turgidulis micare iussit Pendentes, vitreis nouisque ocellis, Ceu bina face, folibúsque[?] binis, Vel ceu splendidulis inuare flammis Languentes oculos, tenebricosos, Annosos simul atque lippientes, Doctus: quum senio retusus hæret Visus, pupula quum stillet[?] tenella Morbo debilitata sæuiore.

Artis qui Medicæ peritiores Machaon, Podalyriúsque frater, Illorúmque parens vel ipse Chiron, Ausi[?] temporibus prioris ævi Herbarum varias docere vires, Et collyria Lumini tuendo, Nescíuere vitri micantis vsus.
Hic sparsos oculi coercet ignes, Extinctos renocat, nouo & latenti Sopitos vegetans vigore sensus, Et longo recreat labore fessos.
Vitreis oculis nouis gemellis Gemelli iuuenum vigent ocelli,

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised. Doubtful: "folibúsque" (letter shapes uncertain, possibly "solibusque"), "stillet" (rendered with a ligature-like form), and "Ausi" (the printed form looks like "Aufi"). The "vegetans" word has a superscript mark over the n that may be a stray ink spot. Catchword "Gemellíque" is set at the right below the last line.
